title: The Cat on the Mat
objectives_ko: 짧은 모음 a(æ) 소리를 알고 -at·-an 단어를 소리를 이어 읽는다
사이트워드 the, on를 보고 읽고, 배운 단어로 된 문장 4개를 읽는다

workbook.title: C. Read and circle.  D. Trace the sentence.

sentences.text: The cat is on the mat.
A rat is in the van.
The can is in the pan.

panels.desc: The sandy bank of the Word Pond. An orange tabby cat sits on a round green doormat at the water's edge, looking across the pond. Three big round wooden beads lie far apart on the sand, each with one letter painted on it: c, a and t — these three letters are the ONLY text allowed in the picture. Pip has hopped onto the beads in the wrong order, t-a-c, and stands on the last one looking puzzled. Beads the bead caterpillar watches from a lily pad; Bun points at the cat; Hedgie scratches his head. Hidden in the picture: the cat, the mat, a small grey rat wearing a tiny red woolly hat peeking out of the grass. Grumble does NOT appear.

lines.text: The cat is on the mat.

panels.desc: Beads has threaded the three beads onto its string in the right order, and with a click-clack they have sunk into the shallow water and become one flat round stepping stone just under the surface. The cat hops onto the stone proudly; Bun and Hedgie cheer with arms up; Pip flutters above with a surprised face. Hidden in the picture: the rat in its red hat sitting on the mat, a brown wooden baseball bat lying on the sand. Grumble does NOT appear.

Further along the bank a small blue delivery van is parked with a light-blue electric fan strapped on its roof; a black frying pan hangs from its mirror and a shiny tin can rolls along the sand. Beads holds up a new string of beads; Hedgie points at the can and the pan; Pip hops beside the can. In the tall reeds behind the van, the top of Grumble's striped nightcap sticks up with the glow of his lantern. Hidden in the picture: the can, the pan, the van, the fan.

Two short rows of round stepping stones now lead a little way out into the pond from the bank. Bun and Hedgie stand on the first stones holding paws; Pip rides on Bun's head; Beads rides on Hedgie's flower; the cat sits on the far stone with the rat. In the reeds at the right, Grumble's frowning face with his dark eye mask peeks out, lantern glowing softly, one paw at his mouth. Hidden in the picture: the fan on the van roof, the green mat on the bank, the baseball bat.

Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.
